text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: P2 - increased p99 latency for /v1/generate in us-west-2. Affected customers: 3. Escalation policy applied.

Alex: oncall here, acked. looking into request routing and recent deploys.

Sam: saw a small config push to inference-router ~20m ago, could be related. tagging @Mike for infra-side checks.

Mike: checking GPU pool health and node restarts now. nothing obvious in node-metrics yet, redis latency normal.

Rachael: I'm stand-by as secondary. If this looks like batching/KV cache issues I can flip routes to the cold model variant.

Alex: good plan. first step: confirm whether the spike is correlated with longer sequences. Sam, can you pull a quick tail on request lengths for the last 30m?

Sam: running query: `SELECT seq_len, count(*) FROM request_logs WHERE service='generation' AND region='us-west-2' AND ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' GROUP BY seq_len ORDER BY seq_len DESC LIMIT 20;`

ops-bot: Automated alert: load on gpool-7 crossed 85% for 3 consecutive minutes.

Mike: found two nodes in gpool-7 showing increased context swap rates and OOM-kill events around the start of the window. suspect memory pressure.

Alex: switching incoming requests for the affected customer routes to region fallback (us-east-1) for now to reduce user impact. Executing routing change via: `curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/route/switch -d '{"from":"us-west-2","to":"us-east-1","routes":["cust-123","cust-456"]}'`

Rachael: ping when done so I can monitor for errors on the fallback. I also have the runbook open: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-spike. Steps 3-6 are the mitigation checklist.

Alex: routing change completed. confirmed fewer 5xx for cust-123 within 2 minutes.

Sam: query results show a tail of large seq_len requests (>=4096) correlated with the spike. volume from a single API token (token-zzz).

Alex: good data. created short-lived token block in the gateway and added to the incident context. Command used: `POST /admin/tokens/block {"token":"token-zzz","ttl":3600}`

Mike: nodes still flapping a bit. I'll drain gpool-7 and spin up replacements with a different kernel param to reduce swapping. ETA ~10m.

Rachael: note — we have reduced on-call coverage tonight after 00:00 UTC (rotation gap). if this runs past the shift end I'll need a clear handoff.

Alex: understood. current plan: Mike completes node rotation, Sam to verify request-length distribution returns to baseline, Rachael to monitor fallback health. If any regression, we'll escalate to urgent infra mobilization.

incident-bot: Incident annotated: incident_id=INC-2026-0421, severity=P2, started_at=1771001234, customer_impact=degraded_performance

Alex: filing ticket to track follow-ups and postmortem: https://tickets.redwood/INC-2026-0421. brief: Memory pressure on gpool-7 due to long-sequence workload, blocked token, routed traffic, node rotation.

Sam: ticket created. assigned to "infra-gpu" and "api-gateway" teams. ticket id: RED-8942.

Rachael: scheduling a short post-handoff retrospective tomorrow 09:00 PDT. I'll add an agenda: runbook gaps, token abuse detection, automatic routing fallback thresholds. Calendar invite: https://calendar.redwood/event/retros-INC-2026-0421

Alex: ok I'm going to hand off primary to Rachael at 23:45 UTC. Summary for oncoming: current state = mitigated (fallback + token block), gpool-7 draining, replacement nodes coming up, watchlist = cust-456, cust-789. action items in ticket RED-8942.

Rachael: taking primary. I'll keep Sam as secondary for 2 hours. note: I have limited escalation access after 02:00 UTC (holiday on-call coverage), so if this needs escalation past that, ping Kevin.

Kevin: gotcha, I can be the escalation pager after 02:00 UTC.

Alex: handing off. please update the ticket with any further findings. I'll do a short writeup in incident doc once I'm off. thanks all. :thumbsup:

Rachael: quick follow-up while taking over — small action item: add a transient admission filter to limit seq_len > 4096 for the affected token class. draft command: ```
PATCH /config/admission
{
  "rule": "block_if ctx.seq_len > 4096 and token.class == 'standard'",
  "ttl": 3600
}
```

Sam: will test rule in staging and if ok we can apply to prod in 10m.

Mike: gpool replacement complete, metrics look stable, memory pressure gone.

ops-bot: All checks passed for gpool-7 replacements.

Rachael: applied admission filter. no further 5xx seen for fallback routes.

Alex: logging final handoff note: primary->Rachael, secondary->Sam, escalation->Kevin after 02:00 UTC. Postmortem owner: Alex (will coordinate with infra for root cause). Retros scheduled by Rachael.

Rachael: filing two follow-ups in RED-8942: (1) Add automated long-seq detection and early token throttling; (2) Update runbook to include explicit fallback routing steps and contact list.

Sam: added logs query and dashboard owner to ticket.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0421 status changed to: monitoring.

Rachael: closing the thread for now — will continue follow-ups in RED-8942 and the retro. thanks.

Alex: thanks team.
